name: Rome
overview: Scripture reveals Rome as a significant center where the gospel of Christ was powerfully proclaimed, with Paul expressing his readiness to preach there and addressing believers as beloved and called to be saints. Despite the city's idolatry and the exclusion of Jews under Claudius Caesar, God's grace and peace are extended to all in Rome, both Jew and Gentile. The gospel is presented as the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, highlighting God's plan to bring salvation through faith in Jesus Christ.
